skill.name: tilt
skill.description: Helps AI assistants inspect Tilt development environments by checking resource status, reading logs, and using Tiltfile references.
skill.summary: Inspect Tilt resources, logs, and Tiltfiles for local development troubleshooting.
skill.author: 0xBigBoss

security_audit.summary: The confirmed findings are expected local command workflows for Tilt, jq, Docker, git, and zmx. Many static hits are Markdown formatting or reference URLs, and I found no prompt injection or data exfiltration intent.

remediation.issue: External command execution in a community skill
remediation.suggestion: Request explicit user confirmation before running state-changing commands such as trigger, up, down, or zmx session creation.

remediation.issue: Tilt logs may contain sensitive data
remediation.suggestion: Warn users before sharing full logs or build errors outside their local environment.

remediation.issue: Placeholder resource names and ports require care
remediation.suggestion: Validate resource names and port values before substituting them into shell commands.

content.value_statement: Tilt failures can hide behind pending states, compose health checks, and scattered logs. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through reliable Tilt status checks, logs, and Tiltfile patterns.
actual_capabilities: Checks Tilt UIResource status with structured filters.
Separates error, pending, in-progress, and compose health states.
Retrieves Tilt logs by resource, time window, tail count, or structured output.
Handles non-default Tilt ports for status and log commands.
Provides Tiltfile references for resources, extensions, file reads, and links.
Starts Tilt in a named zmx session when requested.
limitations: Requires a local Tilt installation and an active project.
Commands can read local logs and resource metadata, which may contain sensitive data.
It does not validate cluster permissions or Kubernetes security settings.
Docker Compose health diagnosis may require Docker access outside Tilt.

use_cases.title: Find Failed Tilt Resources
use_cases.description: Check errors first, then pending states and compose health, so deployment failures are not hidden by noisy output.

use_cases.title: Inspect Recent Logs
use_cases.description: Filter Tilt logs by resource, time window, and tail count while debugging local service changes.

use_cases.title: Review Tiltfile Patterns
use_cases.description: Use resource, extension, file read, and UI link references when maintaining development workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Check Basic Health
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my Tilt app for obvious failures. Start with errors, then summarize pending or in-progress resources.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate One Resource
prompt_templates.prompt: Look at recent logs for the resource named <resource>. Identify likely failure causes and suggest the next check.

prompt_templates.title: Use a Custom Port
prompt_templates.prompt: My Tilt instance runs on port <port>. Inspect resource health and wait for <resource> to become ready.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Tiltfile Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Tiltfile workflow for a multi-service app. Suggest resource grouping, extension usage, links, and safe local commands.

output_examples.input: Check whether my Tilt deployment is healthy.
output: Reported failed resources before pending items.
Called out compose health failures separately.
Recommended re-polling in-progress updates before declaring success.

output_examples.input: Investigate recent errors for the API resource.
output_examples.output: The assistant reports recent error messages, names the affected resource, and suggests the most relevant follow-up check.

output_examples.input: Review my Tiltfile links and grouping.
output_examples.output: The assistant suggests clearer labels and useful local service links for faster navigation in the Tilt UI.

best_practices: Check explicit error states before reading pending or in-progress resources.
Re-poll in-progress updates before reporting a deployment as healthy.
Use structured Tilt output when comparing several resources.
anti_patterns: Do not restart Tilt for ordinary source, manifest, or Tiltfile edits.
Do not treat Docker Compose runtime status as complete health evidence.
Do not paste full logs containing secrets into shared conversations.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands automatically?
faq.answer: It provides command guidance. The assistant should execute commands only when the user allows tool access.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It is intended for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it support non-default Tilt ports?
faq.answer: Yes. It reminds the assistant to pass the selected port for status and log operations.

faq.question: Can it diagnose Docker Compose health failures?
faq.answer: It highlights compose health status and suggests checking Docker health details when Tilt marks a service unhealthy.

faq.question: Can it help edit Tiltfiles?
faq.answer: It can guide Tiltfile changes using the included API reference, but users should review changes before running them.

faq.question: Does it replace Kubernetes monitoring?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on local Tilt development and should complement cluster monitoring tools.
